Exchange credentials for delegation tokens.

Supported grant types and authentication:
- `session_token` (bearer-protected): requires `Authorization: Bearer <Auth0 access token>`. Mints a short-lived (10s) session token bound to the requested integration and project.
- `delegation_token` (integration-secret protected): exchanges a session token plus the integration `app_secret` for a delegation access token (and, when allowed, a refresh token). No bearer token is used.
